scenes.a: Your weary body carries a deep, quiet ache.
scenes.sub: WHEN PAIN RESTS IN THE QUIET

scenes.a: We lean on our own understanding when sickness lingers, yet God’s Word restores us.
Proverbs 3:7-8 promises: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil. It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
Lord, we release the desperate fight to fix what feels broken inside us. Pour your living peace into deep places where strength has dried up.
Bring medicine to weary joints, comfort to strained thoughts, and deep restoration to every bone.
Amen. Rest now, even when your weary body carries a deep, quiet ache.
